# GitHub Copilot Instructions for FlowKit

This repository provides reusable Agent Skills for Business/Systems Analysts and DevOps Engineers.

## Repository Conventions
- Skills are located under `skills/<skill-name>/`.
- Each skill must include:
  - `SKILL.md`: Main instructions with YAML frontmatter (`name`, `description`).
  - Optional support folders: `checklists/`, `examples/`, `references/`, `templates/`.
- No sensitive client data, internal credentials, tokens, or production hostnames should ever be committed.
